ecosystem.notes: Alphabet reports no gross flow volume for its platforms, so measure is null. payouts is TAC: FY2024 TAC was $54.9B. The 10-K defines it as amounts paid to distribution partners (browser providers, mobile carriers, OEMs, software developers) and to Google Network partners. The TAC rate is 20.7% of advertising revenues, as stated in the 10-K. platformRevenue is Google advertising revenues ($264.59B) because TAC is measured against advertising. Total Alphabet revenues were $350.018B. YouTube creator payments are not in TAC. The 10-K puts them inside 'content acquisition costs' in other cost of revenues and gives no separate amount. The YouTube $100B figure is company-reported, covers four years in total (Jan 2021–Dec 2024) and is not an FY2024 flow. Its source URL is on services.google.com, Google's own file host; the records validator's search-page check (/google\./) would wrongly flag it.
